doctorsSql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  s.ID AS Id,
  LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(ISNULL(s.Surname, N''), N' ', ISNULL(s.Name, N''), N' ', ISNULL(s.Patronymic, N'')))) AS Name
FROM dbo.StaffsView s
WHERE ISNULL(s.Archive, 0) = 0
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM dbo.CurrentTimeTable tt
    WHERE tt.ID_Staffs = s.ID
  )
  AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(CONCAT(ISNULL(s.Surname, N''), ISNULL(s.Name, N''), ISNULL(s.Patronymic, N'')))), N'') IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY Name
branchesSql: SELECT DISTINCT oc.ID AS Id, COALESCE(NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(oc.BranchName)), N''), NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(oc.Name)), N''), CONCAT(N'Филиал ', oc.ID)) AS Name FROM dbo.OwnCompanies oc INNER JOIN dbo.Armchairs a ON a.ID_OwnCompanies = oc.ID INNER JOIN dbo.CurrentTimeTable tt ON tt.ID_Armchairs = a.ID WHERE tt.DateOfWork >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND tt.DateOfWork < DATEADD(DAY, 31, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AND (ISNULL(tt.IsWorkingTime, 0) = 1 OR tt.ID_Receptions IS NOT NULL OR tt.ID_TimeReserves IS NOT NULL)
intervalsSql: SELECT DISTINCT CAST(tt.ID_Staffs AS int) AS DoctorId, CAST(a.ID_OwnCompanies AS int) AS BranchId, DATEADD(MINUTE, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, CAST('00:00:00' AS time), tm.TimeStartValue), CAST(tt.DateOfWork AS datetime)) AS StartDateTime, DATEDIFF(MINUTE, tm.TimeStartValue, tm.TimeEndValue) AS LengthInMinutes, CAST(CASE WHEN tt.ID_Receptions IS NOT NULL OR tt.ID_TimeReserves IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS bit) AS IsBusy FROM dbo.CurrentTimeTable tt INNER JOIN dbo.Times tm ON tm.ID = tt.ID_Times INNER JOIN dbo.Armchairs a ON a.ID = tt.ID_Armchairs WHERE tt.ID_Staffs IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(tt.IsHeaderCell, 0) = 0 AND tt.DateOfWork >= CAST(GETDATE() AS date) AND tt.DateOfWork < DATEADD(DAY, 31, CAST(GETDATE() AS date)) AND (ISNULL(tt.IsWorkingTime, 0) = 1 OR tt.ID_Receptions IS NOT NULL OR tt.ID_TimeReserves IS NOT NULL) AND DATEDIFF(MINUTE, tm.TimeStartValue, tm.TimeEndValue) > 0
servicesSql: SELECT DISTINCT si.ID AS Id, si.Name AS Name, sic.Code AS Code, sip.Price AS Price, sip.ID AS PriceId, spg.ID AS PriceGroupId, spg.Name AS PriceGroupName, sf.ID AS FolderId, sf.Name AS FolderName, sc.ID AS CategoryId, sc.Name AS CategoryName FROM dbo.ServiceItems si INNER JOIN dbo.ServiceItemPrices sip ON sip.ID_ServiceItems = si.ID INNER JOIN dbo.ServicePriceGroups spg ON spg.ID = sip.ID_ServicePriceGroups LEFT JOIN dbo.ServiceItemContents sic ON sic.ID_ServiceItems = si.ID AND sic.DateTimeFrom <= GETDATE() AND (sic.DateTimeTo IS NULL OR sic.DateTimeTo > GETDATE()) LEFT JOIN dbo.ServiceFolders sf ON sf.ID = sic.ID_ServiceFoldersParent AND ISNULL(sf.Archive, 0) = 0 LEFT JOIN dbo.ServiceCategories sc ON sc.ID = sf.ID_ServiceCategories AND ISNULL(sc.Archive, 0) = 0 WHERE ISNULL(si.NotAService, 0) = 0 AND NULLIF(LTRIM(RTRIM(si.Name)), N'') IS NOT NULL AND ISNULL(spg.Archive, 0) = 0 AND sip.DateTimeFrom <= GETDATE() AND (sip.DateTimeTo IS NULL OR sip.DateTimeTo > GETDATE()) ORDER BY si.Name, spg.Name
notes: Doctors include every active IDENT staff member with timetable history.
Intervals remain limited to the configured future schedule horizon.
All queries are read-only SELECT statements.
